notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
I found a couple bugs, so i fixed them!

-Removed irrelevant category in the settings
-removed a soft lock in the start of Chapter 4

notes.title: Big Update!
notes.content:
ummm, here are the patch notes/changes

[list]
[*]Increased running speed
[*]Party Swap (allows you to change party members inside of battle)
[*]Visual Overhaul of menus (made it less RPG Maker default and fits the game better)
[*]Exiting the game from the title screen does not crash the game anymore
[*]You can now remap your controls 
[*]You can now have 255 save files + auto save
[*]Max level for main cast has been raised to 256
[*]Insane difficulty has been made even more insane
[*]Fixed all bugs relating to the mouse (i just got rid of it, it was in the way)
[*]Timer system has been replaced and adjusted to make the game easier and more challenging at the same time
[*]Load times relating to the timer are much shorter as a result to the replaced timer system
[*]The Extras menu now has the Launch trailer and the Update trailer
[/list]

I also made a few adjustments to the final dungeon and ending that warrants its own list

[list]
[*]Added a heal point in the lobby
[*]Boss themes are less repetitive
[*]Final boss theme has been changed
[*]Luxrima beam during the ending been centered (I can't tell you how long it has been bugging me)
[*]Credits theme had been adjusted to it is easier to hear
[/list]
